title: MOTION (LEE - BLUMENFIELD) relative to funding median maintenance and beautification, weed & graffiti abatement, alley and street cleanup, and bulky item…
text:
[Council File 26-0011-S28; CD 12]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (LEE - BLUMENFIELD) relative to funding median maintenance and beautification, weed & graffiti abatement, alley and street cleanup, and bulky item pickup in Council District 12.
Recommendations for Council actions, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. TRANSFER and APPROPRIATE that $260,000 of the Council District 12 portion of the Street Furniture Revenue Fund No. 43D/50 to the Board of Public Works Fund No. 100/74, Account No. 3040 (Contractual Services) for various street and neighborhood cleanup and maintenance services throughout Council District 12 coordinated by the Los Angeles Conservation Corps.
2. RESOLVE, that a total of $180,000 in the Sunshine Canyon Communities Amenities Trust Fund No. 699/14 be transferred / appropriated to the Board of Public Works Fund No. 100/74, Account No. 3040 (Contractual Services) for various street and neighborhood cleanup and maintenance services throughout Council District 12 coordinated by the Los Angeles Conservation Corps.
3. AUTHORIZE the Board of Public Works, Office of Community Beautification, to prepare the necessary documents with an/or payments to the Los Angeles Conservation Corps, or any other agency or organization, in the above amount for the above purpose, subject to the approval of the City Attorney as to form.
4. AUTHORIZE that the Department of Public Works, Office of Accounting to make any technical corrections or clarification as necessary to the above instructions in order to effectuate the intent of the motion.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
